name: 31246-batchdecode-minimaxm2-8gpu
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3 -- a whole a3 node (--gres=gpu:8).
parallelism: TP=8 with expert parallelism enabled, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine; no proxy in front, no external cache tier, no KV connector.
architecture: sparse MoE decoder (MiniMaxM2ForCausalLM), 228.7B parameters natively FP8, 8 of 256 experts active per token; the rest is readable off the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 512 requests with a 2400 s safety cap, seed static 31246.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`, single turn, 225 prompt tokens in and exactly 300 tokens out per request, min == max on both sides. Decode-dominated by construction: 300 decode steps against one 225-token prefill.
purpose: A long-form answer assistant on a 229-billion-parameter sparse expert model, short prompts, 32 concurrent streams, eight GPUs.
launch:
model: MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M2
tensor-parallel-size: 8

# Required at this width, not a tuning knob: under plain TP=8 the per-rank expert intermediate
# 1536/8 = 192 is not a multiple of the 128-wide FP8 quantization block and the engine refuses to
# build the weights. Expert parallelism shards the experts across ranks instead.
enable-expert-parallel: true

# The checkpoint carries its own config/model modules.
trust-remote-code: true

# An override: prefix caching is ON by default on this engine, and the workload is a synthetic
# corpus of unrelated prompts.
enable-prefix-caching: false

# The checkpoint's own window is 196608; every request here is 225 in plus 300 out.
max-model-len: 4096
